value: Tissue-specific 3'-end tag RNA-seq of Pleurotus ostreatus cv. Harbor Blue P01 grown in a mycoponic ceramic-tube system

Transcriptome profiling of four mycelial tissue types (exuding mycelium, fuzzy mycelium, exudophore, and nodule) of the oyster mushroom Pleurotus ostreatus cv. "Harbor Blue P01", cultivated on micro-structured ceramic MiniTubes supplied with a liquid mycoponic nutrient medium (Porterfield et al. 2026, doi:10.1002/biot.70184). Libraries are poly(A)-selected 3'-end tag counting libraries with unique molecular identifiers, sequenced single-end on an Illumina NovaSeq X Plus. Four biological replicates per tissue. These data accompany a methods/resource study describing ribosomal RNA dominance and unannotated mitochondrial rDNA in fungal 3'-tag RNA-seq, together with a corrected reference annotation and a draft genome-scale metabolic reconstruction for the species.
